motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Good grief... I'll need to find an excuse to deceive the insurance company.

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: I can't believe I messed up like this!

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: To think I'd encounter them here...! I've got no choice!

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Since I've been exposed, choosing to fight some other day is hardly shameful.

motions.name: login
motions.line: Did you come up with any new ideas, Mastermind? I mean, Commander?

motions.name: login
motions.line: Did you come up with any new ideas, Mastermind? I mean, Commander?

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: What? There's nothing that I want to buy, but don't you feel a sense of achievement when you watch your bank balance grow?

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: Not only do I believe in Santa Claus, I also respect him deeply. Why? It's because there's nowhere in this world that he can't enter!

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: Griffin work aside, I'd be glad to take on any odd jobs you have for me, Mastermind.

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: If the company was more generous with its bonus plan, then I'm sure everyone would be more motivated. Wouldn't you agree, Mastermind?

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: High-risk work that pays well. I expected nothing less of Griffin.

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: After joining Griffin, I was expecting that under your command, I'd be able to complete some great job that nobody had ever done before... <>But I didn't expect that you'd even planned something like this out, Mastermind... <>It seems that whether it comes to plundering the enemy's fortunes or my neural cloud, you certainly cover all the angles.

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Mastermind, you need to tell me if you've got any plans. I can give you preferential treatment.
